name: cloud-terminal
description: Full-featured web terminal plugin for CloudCLI UI

scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-node-pty.js && npx tsc --noEmit && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap && npx esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/server.js --sourcemap --external:node-pty --external:ws
